reason: A15 MTP4 at temperature .6 reproduced a CUDA scatter/gather index assertion before any benchmark sample. The same checkpoint completed the A14 Q172 diagnostic with SPEC_N=0. Measure the disabled-drafter variant to obtain usable context-dependent throughput without attributing it to MTP4.
question: What are the client-observed prefill/decode rates and TTFT for the same TERRA checkpoint at 8K–256K when MTP is disabled and the registered sampler is used?
single_change_from_A15: Set SPEC_N=0; keep weights, image digest, W4A8, BF16, dual-GPU TP=2, fp8 KV, native max context, max sequences, tokenizer, prompt fixture, sampler, output length, cache policy, and serial order fixed.

profile.omit_524288: User instruction A10: no new 512K points; historical Strata Q14 retained as historical evidence only
profile.measurement: Client-observed TTFT and decode duration; prefill = actual prompt_tokens / TTFT, decode = exact completed tokens / decode duration. Report separate from MTP4 and other runtimes.

method: Before the ladder, make one short unscored readiness request with the same .6 sampler. If it fails, do not launch the ladder. Then run 8K×3 and 32K/64K/128K/261888×1, exact 128 output tokens, no cache, no per-context warmups, serially; retain raw JSONL, result JSON and derivation.
quality_context: Reuse A14 Q172 TERRA-MTP-off result 62/100 with safety failures TC-74/84. No additional quality seeds; this is speed/context only and cannot establish adoption suitability.
interpretation: Report as TERRA-MTP-off. Do not combine with or attribute the rates to MTP4, Q34, SOL, ASTRA, or other runtimes. Higher-context n=1 remains exploratory.
